nodes.name: 🔗 Trigger: GitHub CI/CD Webhook
nodes.notes:
⚠️ CREDENTIAL REQUIRED:
No credential node needed here.
But you MUST:
1. Go to GitHub repo → Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook
2. Set Payload URL = https://your-n8n-host/webhook/github-cicd
3. Content type = application/json
4. Set a Secret and store it as env var GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET in n8n
5. n8n validates X-Hub-Signature-256 header via the Code node below

nodes.name: 🔗 Trigger: Manual Complaint Form
nodes.notes:
⚠️ CREDENTIAL REQUIRED:
No credential — this is an open webhook.
Secure it with:
1. Set WEBHOOK_AUTH_TOKEN env var in n8n
2. The normalization Code node validates the X-Auth-Token header
3. Webhook URL = https://your-n8n-host/webhook/manual-ticket
4. Your React frontend sends POST to this URL

nodes.name: 🔗 Trigger: Monitoring Alert
nodes.notes:
⚠️ CREDENTIAL REQUIRED:
No credential node.
Configure in Datadog/PagerDuty/Grafana:
1. Datadog: Integrations → Webhooks → New webhook → URL = https://your-n8n-host/webhook/monitoring-alert
2. PagerDuty: Service → Extensions → Generic Webhook v3
3. Grafana: Alerting → Contact points → Webhook → URL above
4. Validate payload signature in the Code node

nodes.name: 📚 Knowledge Base: Search Similar Incidents
nodes.notes:
⚠️ CREDENTIAL REQUIRED:
Set env var INTERNAL_API_TOKEN in n8n:
n8n Settings → Environment Variables → Add INTERNAL_API_TOKEN
Value must match INTERNAL_API_TOKEN in your backend .env file.
This calls your FastAPI /knowledge/search endpoint.

nodes.name: 🤖 AI Analysis via FastAPI → Claude
nodes.notes:
⚠️ CREDENTIAL REQUIRED:
No credential in n8n directly — Claude API key is stored in FastAPI backend.
In backend/.env:
  ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-api...
Get your key from: https://console.anthropic.com
The INTERNAL_API_TOKEN env var in n8n must match backend INTERNAL_API_TOKEN.

nodes.name: 🔀 Route by Severity
nodes.notes:
Routes CRITICAL/HIGH to the rollback check path.
MEDIUM/LOW/INFO fall through to direct Jira creation.
Both paths merge at the Format Jira Payload node.

nodes.name: 👤 HITL: Slack Rollback Approval Request
nodes.notes:
⚠️ CREDENTIAL REQUIRED:
1. Go to https://api.slack.com/apps → Create New App
2. OAuth & Permissions → Bot Token Scopes: chat:write, channels:join
3. Enable Interactivity → Request URL = https://your-n8n-host/webhook/slack-interactive
4. Install to workspace → copy Bot User OAuth Token
5. In n8n Credentials → New → Slack OAuth2 → paste token
6. Name it 'Slack OAuth2'

nodes.name: ⏳ Wait for Approval (30min timeout)
nodes.notes:
This PAUSES the workflow and waits for a Slack button click.
Slack sends the interactive payload to your n8n Wait webhook.
After 30 min with no response, it times out and routes to rejection path.
Slack interactive URL must be configured in Slack App settings.

nodes.name: 🔄 Execute K8s Rollback (HTTP → Internal API)
nodes.notes:
⚠️ CREDENTIAL REQUIRED:
The INTERNAL_API_TOKEN header authenticates to FastAPI.
FastAPI then calls your internal Kubernetes Deployment API gateway.
Set K8S_DEPLOYMENT_API_URL and K8S_DEPLOYMENT_API_TOKEN in backend .env.
This uses HTTP — no kubectl or kubeconfig in n8n itself.

nodes.name: 🚨 RETRY FAILED: Create Urgent Jira
nodes.notes:
⚠️ CREDENTIAL REQUIRED:
1. Go to id.atlassian.net/manage-profile/security/api-tokens
2. Create API token → copy it
3. In n8n Credentials → New → HTTP Basic Auth
4. Username = your Jira account email (e.g. you@company.com)
5. Password = the API token (NOT your password)
6. Name it 'Jira Basic Auth'
7. Set env var JIRA_BASE_URL = https://yourcompany.atlassian.net
8. Set env var JIRA_PROJECT_KEY = DEVOPS (your project key)

nodes.name: 🚨 Notify Senior DevOps of Rollback Failure

parameters.text: 🔴 *URGENT: Rollback FAILED* — `{{ $json.ticket_id }}` — Deployment `{{ $json.ai.rollback_target }}` in `{{ $json.namespace }}` could NOT be rolled back. *Manual intervention required NOW.* @channel

nodes.name: 🎫 Create Jira Issue
nodes.notes:
⚠️ CREDENTIAL REQUIRED:
Same 'Jira Basic Auth' credential as node n16.
Also needs env vars:
  JIRA_BASE_URL = https://yourcompany.atlassian.net
  JIRA_PROJECT_KEY = DEVOPS
The response body contains the Jira issue key (e.g. DEVOPS-123).

nodes.name: 📣 Send Slack Notification
nodes.notes:
⚠️ CREDENTIAL REQUIRED:
Same 'Slack OAuth2' credential as node n11.
Scopes needed: chat:write, channels:read, channels:join
Slack App must be added to your workspace channels.

nodes.name: ⏰ Schedule: Check Escalations Every 5min
nodes.notes:
Runs every 5 minutes independently.
Checks for tickets unresolved after 30-minute escalation deadline.
Finds tickets in OPEN or INVESTIGATING status past their escalation_deadline.
No credentials needed.

main.node: 🚨 Notify Senior DevOps of Rollback Failure
